# The Location Optimization Playground


## Task

We're now going to put you into rooms to work through a location optimization problem together.

To begin with, you won't have this technique available to you - but you will have an analyst who has been trained to create some of the kinds of maps we've talked about today.


## The scenario

You are responsible for the provision of community diagnostic centres in Devon.

You have been tasked with opening one additional centre.

You have been told to prioritise access for those aged 50-84, and for those in more deprived areas.
